_doc: Aluminium alloy EN AW-6063 T5, extruded, for analysis: what framing profiles are made of. Strengths are the least EN 755-2:2016 allows for a wall of 10 mm or less, as Hydro's data sheet gives them; a maker's own profile may be stronger. No fatigue figure: the sheet gives none.
name: al6063-t5

modulus.source: Hydro, Technical datasheet, Extruded products, Alloy EN AW-6063, Rev.4 03/2023, https://hydro.com/globalassets/08-about-hydro/hydro-worldwide/austria/nenzing/alloy-data-sheets/hydro-en-aw-6063.pdf

poisson.rule: Poisson's ratio, worked out from the sheet's modulus of elasticity (69 GPa) and of rigidity (26 GPa): E / 2G - 1
poisson.source: Hydro, Technical datasheet, Extruded products, Alloy EN AW-6063, Rev.4 03/2023, https://hydro.com/globalassets/08-about-hydro/hydro-worldwide/austria/nenzing/alloy-data-sheets/hydro-en-aw-6063.pdf

shear_modulus.rule: Modulus of rigidity (26 GPa, typical at 20 °C)
shear_modulus.source: Hydro, Technical datasheet, Extruded products, Alloy EN AW-6063, Rev.4 03/2023, https://hydro.com/globalassets/08-about-hydro/hydro-worldwide/austria/nenzing/alloy-data-sheets/hydro-en-aw-6063.pdf

strength.rule: 0.2% proof stress Rp0.2, the least EN 755-2:2016 allows in temper T5 for a wall of 10 mm or less
strength.source: Hydro, Technical datasheet, Extruded products, Alloy EN AW-6063, Rev.4 03/2023, https://hydro.com/globalassets/08-about-hydro/hydro-worldwide/austria/nenzing/alloy-data-sheets/hydro-en-aw-6063.pdf

ultimate.rule: Tensile strength Rm, the least EN 755-2:2016 allows in temper T5 for a wall of 10 mm or less
ultimate.source: Hydro, Technical datasheet, Extruded products, Alloy EN AW-6063, Rev.4 03/2023, https://hydro.com/globalassets/08-about-hydro/hydro-worldwide/austria/nenzing/alloy-data-sheets/hydro-en-aw-6063.pdf

density.source: Hydro, Technical datasheet, Extruded products, Alloy EN AW-6063, Rev.4 03/2023, https://hydro.com/globalassets/08-about-hydro/hydro-worldwide/austria/nenzing/alloy-data-sheets/hydro-en-aw-6063.pdf
